Dates below are civil Gregorian dates. Julian fixed feasts also show their liturgical month and day. The revised-calendar option uses matching Gregorian fixed dates within this reader’s 1900–2099 range. Both options retain the traditional Julian Paschalion.

The next-12-month view starts on today’s date in your browser’s local time and ends before the corresponding date 12 months later. It refreshes when reopened, at local midnight, or when you return to the tab. This is a learning calendar of selected feasts and seasons, not a complete parish Typikon, daily lectionary, or personal fasting rule.
